description: This file defines a WPF UserControl named 'Settings' for a calculator application, handling UI interactions, localization, theme selection, and accessibility announcements.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A sealed partial class representing the settings UI control for the calculator app, managing theme, localization, accessibility, and feedback interactions.

methods.name: Settings
methods.description: Constructor initializing the settings control, setting up localization, content, and UI elements.

methods.name: OnThemeSelectionChanged
methods.description: Handles theme selection changes by updating the application's root theme.

methods.name: SetDefaultFocus
methods.description: Sets focus to the theme expander control.

methods.name: OnLoaded
methods.description: Event handler invoked when the control is loaded; sets up back navigation and accessibility announcements.

methods.name: AnnouncePageOpened
methods.description: Announces that the settings page has been opened for accessibility.

methods.name: OnUnloaded
methods.description: Event handler invoked when the control is unloaded; cleans up event subscriptions.

methods.name: FeedbackButton_Click
methods.description: Launches the feedback URI with the current app version.

methods.name: InitializeAboutContentTextBlock
methods.description: Initializes the about content text block, primarily setting version info.

methods.name: SetVersionString
methods.description: Sets the version string in the about section based on app package version.

methods.name: InitializeContributeTextBlock
methods.description: Prepares the contribute text block with hyperlink text, parsing resource string.

methods.name: System_BackRequested
methods.description: Handles the system back request, invoking the back button automation pattern.

methods.name: BackButton_Click
methods.description: Raises the BackButtonClick event to notify parent components.
